title: Gymnastics
paras: Exercises for boys were created in the 1800s.
They came from old exercises from Greece.
This would become gymnastics.
Gymnasts have 8 stations.
Women use 4 of them for events.
Men use 6.
They share 2 stations.
Nadia Comaneci shocked the world in 1976.
She is the first to get a perfect score at the Olympics.
She got 7 of them.
Kohei Uchimura won world titles five years in a row.
He won the all-around from 2009 to 2013.
He is the first to do this.
Gabby Douglas made history in 2012.
She won Olympic gold for all-around.
She was the first black woman to do this.
Vitaly Scherbo had one of the best Olympics in 1992.
He won 6 out of 8 events.
He won the team gold.
He also won 5 solo events.
Only two swimmers have won more in one Olympics.
Team USA is fighting for gold in 1996.
The last event is the vault.
Kerri Strug is America's last hope.
She falls on her first go.
She hurts her ankle.
She must go again.
She limps to the start.
She runs.
She lands.
She scores a 9.712!
USA wins its first gold in team gymnastics!
Strug has to be carried to the medal stand.

notes.phonics: l_nds·b_st·l_mps·m_st이 모두 자음 두 개로 끝납니다. 끝소리를 먼저 읽고 가운데 모음을 넣게 해 주세요. b_st와 m_n이 둘 다 e예요.
notes.scan: 이 지문은 지금까지 중 가장 깁니다(33문장). 문항 넷이 지문 앞·중간·끝에 골고루 있으니, 답을 하나 찾을 때마다 쉬어 가도 됩니다. 넷 다 답이 숫자나 짧은 낱말이에요.
notes.tf: 이 지문의 마지막 열두 문장은 케리 스트럭 이야기입니다 — 발목을 다치고도 다시 뛰어 금메달을 딴 이야기예요. 4번을 맞히려면 마지막 문장까지 읽어야 합니다. "그래서 혼자 걸어갔어?" 하고 물어봐 주세요.
notes.trace: 두 번째는 두 낱말뿐입니다. 짧지만 이 이야기에서 가장 중요한 순간이에요 — 다친 발목으로 착지한 장면이지요.
